propositions: Pure single-pass prepacked evidence verification yields false-positive rejections when prepack is incomplete; a PASS/ABSTAIN-only filter followed by narrowed agentic fallback eliminates false-positive rejects by construction.

Filter coverage is bimodal by AC style: ACs naming greppable artifacts (tests, symbols, files) PASS from static packs at 90%+ rates; ACs asserting runtime outcomes or store-side artifacts rationally ABSTAIN, yielding 0-39% overall real-ticket coverage.

Filter+fallback achieves -26% total token cost vs pure-agentic on this corpus (-46% on real tickets only), with filter cost negligible (~0.4%), while maintaining zero false-positive PASSes on adversarial unmet ACs.

The criteria-reduction seam (AC-block rewrite at ticket load via monkeypatched show_ticket) successfully narrows agentic budget and auto-derives step floor; filter-PASSed ACs can be recorded with citations for auditability.
Deterministic 8000-char description admission cap in verify_completion blocks over-cap tickets; adversarial AC edits must be length-neutral and productized reducer must re-check cap after reduction.
Agentic verifier exhibits low-rate false-FAIL variance (2 of 12 runs) on genuinely-met ACs; filter design narrows but does not eliminate this residual risk.
